description:
This notice was posted to identify sources that can manufacture NSN 2590-01-693-7794 and are interested in quoting a solicitation.  This notice was posted for the purpose of market research only and is not a Request for Proposal (RFP).  Please review the NSN below and provide any sources that may be able to manufacture the item.  The sources that are currently approved to manufacture this Winch Parts Kits are listed below.  If you are interested in this requirement, please complete the attached Market Research Questionnaire.  All information should be submitted to the Contract Specialist, Natalee Corder, at Natalee.Corder@dla.mil no later than March 8th, 2026. 

The approved sources and part numbers are listed below:

NSN:  2590-01-693-7794

Description: Winch Parts Kits

Approved Source and Part Number: Lake Shore Systems, Inc. (cage 34712), P/N P012781

AMC: 3

AMSC: Q

No data is available. An alternate offeror is required to provide a complete data package including data for the approved and alternate part for evaluation.
